evidence.curator_note: Continuation of the upper branch of Equation 8.56: the reaction arrow labelled 'alpha' that leaves the m/z 56 ion and points to 'CH2=CH2+. + C2H4, m/z 28, 65%'. Radical-site alpha-cleavage of the tetramethylene radical cation splits the central C4-C5 bond into two C2H4 units. Book draws 0 arcs for this step (only the 'alpha'-labelled reaction arrow); all three fishhooks encoded here are curator-supplied for electron balance. DRAWN vs ENCODED: the page draws the ion as CH2=CH2+., whose pi bond holds only ONE electron; a one-electron pi bond has no SMILES representation, so the product ion is encoded as the distonic isomer +CH2-CH2. that the arrows actually produce and that relaxes to the drawn CH2=CH2+. (identical composition C2H4+., identical m/z 28.031). The two C2H4 halves are equivalent, so which half retains the charge is fixed by the arrow bookkeeping (radical-site initiation at the C3 terminus, charge retention at the original carbenium terminus C6), not by anything printed on the page.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no entry for 8.56; no MØD rule variable is cross-linked to this scheme. The species undergoing this step is an EI fragment ion (m/z 56), NOT the molecular ion, so adduct is null and precursor_mz is the fragment mass; the page names no CAD or MI experiment, so this is a consecutive decomposition inside the 70 eV EI source and the printed 65% is an ordinary EI abundance.

ms_context.activation_method: electron ionization (consecutive decomposition of an EI fragment ion)
